app.name: PureProjects
app.description: Track knowledge-work projects: deliverables with dates and owners, the next action, what you are waiting on, and the documents each project pulls together.

tools.name: fn_portfolioBriefing
tools.description: Generate a single-call executive portfolio briefing across PureProjects: currently open project, status totals, overdue and upcoming projects and deliverables, stalled waits sorted oldest-first and grouped by person, per-person workload, area breakdown, and a hygiene audit with health score. Filter optionally by area, status, person, or query.

person.description: Optional person name filter (matches project people, deliverable owners, or waits).

includeArchived.description: Include archived projects alongside living ones (default false).

horizonDays.description: Days ahead for upcoming project and deliverable deadlines (default 7, range 1–90).

staleWaitDays.description: Days waiting before flagging a wait as stale (default 7, range 1–90).

staleProjectDays.description: Days without updates before flagging an active project as stale (default 14, range 1–180).

asOfDate.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD or ISO reference date (defaults to today).

tools.name: fn_getProjectDossier
tools.description: Retrieve a complete operational dossier for one project (defaults to the currently open project when projectId is omitted): full metadata, categorized open/overdue/completed deliverables, next-action match, owner breakdown, aged waits, journal history, categorized links, and optional block previews of linked PureWriter documents.

projectId.description: Target project id. Omit to inspect the currently open project.

includeDocumentPreviews.description: Read linked .document packages and include leading block previews (default false).

previewBlockLimit.description: Maximum blocks per document preview when includeDocumentPreviews is true (default 5, range 1–30).

journalLimit.description: Maximum recent journal entries to include (default 25, range 1–100).

asOfDate.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD or ISO reference date (defaults to today).

tools.name: fn_kickoffProject
tools.description: Create and scaffold a complete PureProjects project in one atomic call: sets project metadata, adds initial deliverables (optionally promoting the first as nextAction), records initial waits, links reference documents or web pages, appends a kickoff journal entry, and optionally creates a linked PureWriter document. Call getProjectsContext first.

summary.description: Short description of the project goal.

status.description: Initial status (default "active"; becomes "waiting" automatically if waitingOn entries are given).

autoSetNextAction.description: When nextAction is omitted and deliverables are supplied, set nextAction to the first deliverable title (default true).

journalEntry.description: Optional kickoff decision/context entry for the journal.

initialDocument.description: Optional PureWriter .document package to create and link.

tools.name: fn_updateProjectProgress
tools.description: Apply a coordinated check-in to one project in a single atomic transaction (defaults to the currently open project): add and update deliverables, resolve or stack waits, promote a deliverable to nextAction or update project fields, and log a journal entry. Supports dryRun preview without mutating.

projectId.description: Target project id. Omit to target the currently open project.

promoteDeliverableId.description: Open deliverable id to promote as the project nextAction.

resolveWaitingIds.description: Specific waitingIds that arrived and should be cleared.

clearAllWaits.description: Clear every outstanding wait on the project.

addWaits.description: New waits to stack onto the project.

dueAt.description: ISO due date, or empty string to clear.

tools.name: fn_batchRebalanceProjects
tools.description: Execute a validated multi-project review and rebalancing batch in one atomic mutation: update fields, add or remove people, archive or restore projects, append journal entries across multiple projects, and move deliverables between projects. Supports dryRun preview without persisting.

dryRun.description: Preview every change without writing to the store (default false).

archive.description: true to archive, false to restore into view.

tools.name: fn_prepareHandoverPackage
tools.description: Assemble a project handover package in one call (defaults to the currently open project): optionally generate and link a PureWriter status-brief document summarizing deliverables, waits, and decisions, export the project documents as PDFs and/or a ZIP archive, and optionally log the handover in the project journal. Call getProjectsContext first.

projectId.description: Target project id. Omit to use the currently open project.

includeStatusBrief.description: Generate and link a fresh PureWriter status-brief .document before exporting (default false).

briefTitle.description: Optional custom title for the generated status brief.

extraBriefHtml.description: Optional extra HTML section appended to the generated status brief.

documentPaths.description: Optional subset of linked document paths to export. Omit to export every document on the project.

logHandoverInJournal.description: Append a journal entry recording the handover bundle (default false).

journalNote.description: Optional custom note included in the handover journal entry.

tools.name: getProjectsContext
tools.description: Overview of projects, including openProject (the project currently on screen), totals by status, overdue work, waits and missing next actions. Call first. Unqualified add/todo requests target openProject; act without asking for optional owner or date details.

tools.name: listProjects
tools.description: List projects with their status, next action, people, due date and area. Filter by status, area, or a free-text query. Use before proposing changes so ids and current values are exact.

archived.description: List archived projects instead of live ones. Archived projects are out of view by default.

query.description: Free-text match on name, next action, or people.

tools.name: getProject
tools.description: One project in full: description, deliverables with owners and due dates, journal entries, linked documents, and what it is waiting on.

tools.name: updateProject
tools.description: Change a project's status, next action, due date, area, summary or people. Only the fields you pass are changed.

dueAt.description: ISO date, or an empty string to clear it.

tools.name: addDeliverable
tools.description: Add a todo/deliverable. An unqualified request such as add X targets the currently open project: omit projectId to use it. Act without asking for optional details; omit owner for the user and dueAt when no date was given.

projectId.description: Explicit target project id. Omit to use the currently open project.

owner.description: Who owes it. Omit for the user.

dueAt.description: ISO date. Omit when no deadline was given.

tools.name: deleteProject
tools.description: Delete a project permanently, with its deliverables, journal and links. This cannot be undone - prefer archiveProject, which puts it out of view and keeps the whole record. Only delete when the user asks to remove something outright.

name.description: The project's exact current name, as a guard against deleting the wrong one.

tools.name: discoverAppTools
tools.description: Discover PureProjects's extended specialist tools (17 tools across deliverables, documents, exports, journal, links, projects, waits) and composite functions (6 workflows). Prefer calling exposed composite functions and core tools first; use discoverAppTools when an edge case needs a specialist tool, then call it via callExtendedReadTool (for read-only tools) or callExtendedTool (for mutating tools).

query.description: Optional keywords describing the capability you need (e.g. "deliverables", "documents", "exports", "journal", "links").

category.description: Optional category filter (deliverables, documents, exports, journal, links, projects, waits, or "all").

names.description: Optional exact tool names to fetch full JSON input schemas for.

includeFunctions.description: Include already-exposed composite functions and core tools in the listing (default false: searches extended tools first).

tools.name: callExtendedReadTool
tools.description: Call one of PureProjects's read-only extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: deliverables, documents, exports, journal, links, projects, waits). Strictly refuses mutating, destructive, external, or release tools.

tool.description: Exact name of a read-only extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

tools.name: callExtendedTool
tools.description: Call one of PureProjects's mutating extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: deliverables, documents, exports, journal, links, projects, waits). For destructive tools, set confirmDestructive: true after checking with the user. Strictly refuses read-only tools (use callExtendedReadTool), external tools, permanent-delete tools, and release tools.

tool.description: Exact name of a mutating extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

confirmDestructive.description: Required (true) when calling an extended tool marked risk: "destructive".
